Opt in to OCR elements to get each word's text, bounding box and confidence

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"image/png\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png\"}", "{\"force_ocr\":true,\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"tesseract\",\"element_config\":{\"include_elements\":true,\"min_level\":\"word\"},\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"eng\"]}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
